capabilities: Render a scrollable, zoomable timeline of vault records from detected dates, content dates, and tracked edits
Filter and fuzzy-search timeline records across filenames, content, summaries, and attributes
Manage records through review states, pinning, marking, renaming, moving, and daily note creation
Generate AI summaries and zoomable Epoch timemaps via a local AI bridge (Pro)
Find related notes through links, tags, title and semantic similarity, and sync ICS calendar feeds (Pro)
extras: Freemium: core timeline is free, but tracked changes, Epochs, similarity, AI summaries, and calendar sync require a paid Pro license validated against a cloud server. The AI bridge starts a local server and, in native mode, uses Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano Summarizer API (desktop-only, needs ~22 GB free disk). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Vaults fill up with quick capture notes, and users lose track of when things happened and which notes belong to the same theme or activity.

relations.evidence: Use Obsidian protocol to add Epochgram.

requires.name: Cloud summarization provider key for AI bridge cloud mode

summary: Interactive, zoomable timeline that turns vault notes into dated records, with search, review states, and optional AI summaries and similarity marking.
